resources.string: Independent app. Not endorsed by USGS. Data from official agencies.
Welcome to the Kilauea Alerts App,\n\nMahalo nui loa for joining us during this testing build. Your feedback helps us polish something genuinely useful for Hawaiʻi Island.

The six tabs along the bottom take you everywhere: Home for Kīlauea status and quick reads, Earthquakes for recent activity, Weather for island forecasts, Live Feeds for cameras and streams, Alerts for official USGS volcano notices and NWS alerts, and More for notifications and settings.
Optional accounts and premium features may be added later. For now, this build focuses on timely official alerts and a clear overview.
Explore safely, stay informed, and tell us what would help you most. We appreciate you.
